learning_outcomes.description: Apply foodservice management principles and a systems approach to assess, plan and evaluate processes or quality improvement opportunities within a foodservice.
Demonstrate project management skills by critically investigating foodservice practice problems using research, evidence and evaluation, and developing practical, feasible recommendations.
Demonstrate effective collaboration, teamwork and communication skills, with peers and interdisciplinary teams.
Demonstrate safe, ethical, professional and culturally responsive dietetic practice.
Proactively engage in feedback and reflective processes to identify areas for improvement and enhance professional practice performance.
